changelog:
- Initial release of the "browse-anything" skill.
- Allows users to delegate any web task to a real Chromium browser controlled by an autonomous agent.
- Supports booking, scraping, form filling, live lookups, login flows, data extraction behind authentication, and automated checkouts.
- Requires a BrowseAnything API key for operation; guided setup instructions provided.
- Offers both high-level (single-command) and low-level (manual control) workflows, including human-in-the-loop handling.
- Provides clear troubleshooting, usage tips, and guidance on prompt authoring for optimal results.
